field.name: family tools are checked at run time and typed for callTool as TSchema
field.type: A tool built from an op table (defineGhFamily, defineJiraFamily) returns GhFamilyTool = TypedTool & { ops }, whose inputSchema and outputSchema are TSchema, so callTool<T>'s Static<T['inputSchema']> and Static<T['outputSchema']> are not concrete per family; the shapes are enforced at run time by the executor's input check before execute and its output check after execute (failed('schema-mismatch') when the declared output gets no data or data outside the union)
field.purpose: Records the level of typing the op-table family tools actually give: run-time-checked shapes, no concrete per-family compile-time types. A concrete per-family type is left to a later Story.

body.rationale: sc2 promises a result typed from the tool definition. The 22 approved gh families and the five Jira families are built from an op table whose schemas are plain TSchema, so they meet the run-time half of sc2 (checked input and checked output) but not the compile-time half. The contract should say so instead of leaving the gap implicit. The amendment is additive and changes no existing tool.
